Cc: procurement@cairnhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extra credits for private VPC pilot (security review)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the help during the demo last week. Our security team is running a deeper validation of the Private/VPC POC and asked us to exercise a fuller data flow (audit logs + payload hashing) which pushed our evaluation over the credits we were originally given.

We need a short extension / top-up of credits to complete the compliance run — roughly 7 to 10 days — so we can produce the artifacts they asked for (network diagram, ingestion logs, and end-to-end traces). Without a few extra GPU hours the trial will stall and the security review will time out.

Attached is the compliance checklist they sent. Can Redwood provide an additional, limited credit extension tied to SOC2 evidence access? Also let me know if you need a point of contact on our security team.

Best,
Emma Lane

Cairn Health

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the checklist.

We can definitely support a short, scoped extension for a compliance-driven run. A couple quick Qs to size the request so I can route for approval:
- Roughly how many documents / tokens do you expect to process per day during the run?
- Do you need us to keep expanded audit logs (longer retention) or just provide snapshots for the SOC review?
- Preferred window: 7 or 10 days?

cc'ing Dev (solutions) to propose an infra footprint and a minimal isolation plan (sandbox VPC + restricted credentialing) so we can limit blast radius. Once we have those numbers I can escalate to Sales for a promotional credit allocation and loop in Jordan in procurement if legal/po steps are needed.

If it's easier, we can schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 415-555-0198

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra credits for private VPC pilot (security review)

Thanks for looping me in. Quick sizing guidance based on similar POCs:
- Small compliance run (audit traces + sample payloads): ~120k tokens/day, ~6 GPU-hours/day on a g4-equivalent runtime.
- Full ingestion + longer retention (30-day trace window): ~350k tokens/day, ~18 GPU-hours/day.

For the shortest path to evidence, I recommend the small run + manual snapshots. We can deploy a dedicated sandbox in your VPC with restricted inbound rules and a read-only service account for auditors. I attached a short POC run template that lists required config flags.

If Cairn's security lead can share a contact, I can prepare the network diagram and the minimal-binding IAM policies for review.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: poc_run_template.md
